title: Highway Lines Are Way Bigger Than You Think
hook: Your sense of scale on a road is simply wrong, and by a lot.

cast.note: The narration names Bill directly, so the scale gag IS the episode. Mina holds the measuring tape and enjoys it.

scenes.note: Driver's-eye view at frame 0. The lines look small on purpose — that is the lie being set up.

beats.action: driver's-eye view down a highway; dashes streaming toward camera, looking tiny
one dash is circled as it passes
the circled dash swells violently for six frames then snaps back; camera punch

scenes.note: Switch to top-down so a measurement is readable. The number gets drawn, not stated.

beats.action: hard cut to a top-down view of one lane; a single dash sits centre frame
the dash outlines and a dimension line draws along it
10 FEET card stamps on the dimension line

scenes.note: The gap is three times the dash. Draw it at true relative length so the eye does the maths.

beats.action: camera pulls back to reveal the gap after the dash
30 FEET card stamps on the gap; it is visibly three times the dash

scenes.note: Return to the driver's eye with the truth now known. Same shot, different meaning.

beats.action: cut back inside the car; Bill at the wheel, lines streaming past looking tiny again
the perspective lines pulse; the dashes near the horizon squeeze to nothing
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: perspective lines draw over the shot, converging at the horizon
the dashes shrink to little paint flecks; a LIE stamp flickers over them for four frames

scenes.note: The scale gag the script asks for by name. Bill must be visibly, comically shorter than the line.

beats.action: Bill walks the full length of the upright line and does not reach the top
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: 3 METRES card stamps; a human-height ruler draws itself
Bill walks on and stands beside a single road line stood on its end
beats.sync: keyword: Bill — he is named in the narration

beats.action: the line towers over him; Bill goes tiny and horrified; Mina holds the tape and looks delighted
a height-comparison bracket snaps between the two; Bill loses badly

scenes.note: The reveal turns inward: the road was never the problem. Hard cut.

beats.action: back to the driving view; the road ahead
the whole road visibly compresses under the car like a squeezed accordion
Bill's eye twitches; a tiny brain icon pops beside his head looking guilty; hard cut
beats.sync: keyword: this entire time — final beat
